_about: Every market/cost assumption used by sim/engine.py. Each block has a `_source` map: key -> where the number comes from (panel, competitor page, public benchmark, or 'estimate'). Numbers marked 'estimate' are placeholders for the CEO to recalibrate from founder/panel and the competitor map. Money in EUR; rates are per week unless the key says _monthly / per_month.

_source.search_strategies: SPEC suggests 300 x 150 then top 10 x 1,000; raised to 800 x 200 (5 generations) and top 10 x 2,000 fresh seeds because a full run still takes ~6-10 min on 2 vCPU
_source.seeds_sensitivity: 600 seeds gives ~+/-2pp standard error on a 50% survival rate (common random numbers make +/- comparisons tighter)

_source.sandbox_floor: estimate: share of competitive-model clicks during the sandbox (brand + ultra-long-tail)
_source.backlinks_per_page: estimate: natural links earned per page published
_source.focus_seo_bonus: SPEC: one-segment focus gives a GEO/topical bonus (SEO ranking uses seo_competition.rank.focus_bonus)
_source.yield_sigma: estimate: per-run lognormal uncertainty on SEO yield

_source.tiers: founder/seo-competition.json (Semrush API via MCP (40 calls, ~9,800 API units), 2026-10-14) via sim/calibrate_seo.py. monthly_volume = tier total searches/month (us+fr; Semrush undercounts B2B long-tail, see marketing.seo.yield_sigma); kd = tier average KD; top10_authority = median of sampled per-keyword top-10 median Authority Scores; pages_needed = keywords x {'A': 1.5, 'B': 3.0, 'C': 5.0} pages per keyword; content_share = share of new pages written for the tier (estimate)
_source.tier_segments: estimate: which segments search these keywords (the analyst's set is built around the small-SaaS beachhead: alternatives, AI onboarding, chatbot, mascot). Clicks are split across segments with these shares; only the targeted segments' share (+ non-target spill) is covered by our content
_source.ctr: founder/seo-competition.json (Semrush API via MCP (40 calls, ~9,800 API units), 2026-10-14) via sim/calibrate_seo.py: Assumption, not measured: blended average of public organic CTR curves (pos 1 ~25-30%, pos 3 ~10%) discounted ~25% for AI Overviews and ads on commercial SaaS SERPs; pos 4-10 ~2-6%; page 2 <1%.
_source.authority_anchor: founder/seo-competition.json (Semrush API via MCP (40 calls, ~9,800 API units), 2026-10-14) via sim/calibrate_seo.py: New domain starts at AS 0-2. Plan in marketing.md (10 directories W2, G2/Capterra W4, Show HN + 500-flow study W5, generator W6) plausibly yields 30-60 referring domains by M3 (AS ~5), 100-150 by M6 (AS ~10-15; productonboarding.com is AS 16 with 1,511 ref domains, helphero.co AS 22 with 576), 200-300 quality RDs by M12 (AS ~18-22). Semrush AS is logarithmic and weights link quality, so these are estimates.
_source.authority_sigma: estimate: per-run lognormal uncertainty on our authority
_source.ref_links_per_week: estimate: referring domains/week the anchors assume; our authority = anchor x clamp(((our links + offset)/(ref links + offset))^exponent, min, max)
_source.link_building_share: estimate: share of SEO hours spent on links (guest posts, PR, directories) instead of pages
_source.links_per_hour: estimate: referring domains earned per link-building hour
_source.rank: r = auth_coef*ln((A+1)/(T+1)) - kd_coef*(KD-kd_ref)/100 + depth_coef*ln(1+min(depth,3)) + focus_bonus + per-run noise; keyword-level r ~ N(r, kw_sigma); share in top 3/10/20 = Phi((r-t)/kw_sigma). auth_coef, kd_coef, t3, t10, t20 FITTED by calibrate_seo.py to the analyst's position_share_assumptions at months 6 and 12 (RMSE 0.028 on cumulative shares), assuming full content depth and a focused site; kw_sigma, kd_ref, depth_coef, focus_bonus, run_sigma are estimates. 'Outranks the median competitor' = r >= (t3+t10)/2 with depth >= 0.3
_source.brand_visits_per_1k_followers_week: estimate: brand searches per week per 1,000 social followers (counted as organic)
_source.competitors: founder/seo-competition.json (Semrush API via MCP (40 calls, ~9,800 API units), 2026-10-14) via sim/calibrate_seo.py: reported in the results, not used in the maths (tier top10_authority is)
_source.analyst_expected_clicks: founder/seo-competition.json (Semrush API via MCP (40 calls, ~9,800 API units), 2026-10-14) via sim/calibrate_seo.py: the analyst's own clicks/month estimate (comparison only)
